page: Hardware faults: memory or cache errors that were not corrected, failing disks, power loss, overheating, bad cables or interconnect links.
Crashes, panics, and components that stopped or cannot start.
Storage failures: filesystems that fail to mount, I/O errors, data corruption.
Communication failures between parts of the system: lost connections, sockets closed unexpectedly, failed network links.
Resource exhaustion: out of memory, full disks, exhausted connection pools.
Security incidents: intrusion attempts or unauthorized access.
do_not_page: Errors caused by a user or client: bad input, missing or invalid files or programs the user supplied, permission denied for a user's request.
Problems the system reports as automatically corrected, retried successfully, or recovered.
Routine status, progress, configuration, and informational messages.
Warnings about conditions that are not yet affecting service.
